## 🔧 fix evidence — review round 3 (PR #4441)

Verify is GREEN for `697fa7c05` (diff-selected gate, 86 tests within 1 import hop plus the repo-scan tests); the harness pushed that sha to `lane/review-ruling-resume`.

### Finding 1 — security: `covered` suppression used the loose #76a identity (PLAUSIBLE)

**Before (red)** — new tests on the unfixed code: a different defect on the same path and quote anchor was `covered` at every lens.
```
FAIL classifyReferralsByRound — "covered" needs the same claim, not just a shared quote anchor
  > a DIFFERENT defect on the same path and quote anchor is not covered ("correctness" lens)
  > ... ("security" lens) / ("simplicity" lens) / (undefined lens)
Tests  4 failed | 69 passed (73)
```
**After (green)** — `review-ruling-resume`, `review-referral-hold`, `jury-core`: 535 passed. `covered` now needs an active referral on THIS head holding the identical claim (`exactClaimKey`, line refs kept; stored per head as `activeInstances` in the identity table and projected through `review-pr.mjs`), checked across ALL bound entries. A look-alike that is not covered takes the round rule (gate lens → referral, advisory lens → card suggestion).

Wiring mutation: dropping `activeInstances` from the `review-pr.mjs` projection reddens the reduce-level test "the repeated finding is covered by identity…" (1 failed), so a missing projection cannot silently bring back the re-park.

### Finding 2 — codex-correctness: the no-cited-line test could not exercise its guard (CONFIRMED)
New test: an advisory seat re-raising with no usable cited line (undefined / null / 0 / '' / 'x') and changed lines `[1]` stays mandatory, with a cited-line positive control that IS demoted.
Mutation (guard replaced by coercing a missing line to 0): `5 failed | 68 passed`. With the guard restored: green.

### Variants considered
Defect class: a loose match removes (or lets through) a gate-lens finding on identity that cannot tell a re-wording from a different defect.
- Shared quote anchor, different claim, same path → **fixed** (jury-core `classifyReferralsByRound`, `coveredByActiveClaim`).
- Same path + anchor, different LENS entries kept apart by the table; first-match shadowing → **fixed** (all bound entries are checked; test "finds the exact claim on a LATER entry").
- Claim differing only in a `:line` reference (templated summary; `normSummary` folds it to `:N`) → **fixed** (`exactClaimKey` keeps line refs; test "a templated claim differing only in its :line reference…").
- Exact claim covered on ANOTHER head → **fixed** (per-head `activeInstances`; test "an exact-claim match on ANOTHER head…").
- Table built without `activeInstances` (stale caller / resumed old read) → not covered, the safe direction (`?? []`).
- Re-wording of the same claim by a gate seat is now referred again rather than covered: **accepted on purpose** ("when unsure, keep separate"). The cost is one extra ruling, not a skipped gate finding. I chose a claim-only test over `sameInstanceForCarry` (line window 8 + severity) because that window would break the #4361 replay (re-raise at line 43, original at 29); a same claim at a drifted line on the same unchanged head is the same defect.
- Advisory `FIXER_ADDRESSED_RERAISE` demotion still binds loosely: **n/a** — advisory-only and the finding becomes a recorded card suggestion, not a drop; it now at least picks a block-ruled entry among all bound entries instead of the first. Filed as a prevention note below.
- `review-pr.mjs` `bindFindingIds` promotion of blocked referrals only tightens; `review-shadow-agreement.mjs` only labels: **n/a**.
- `activeReferrals` vs `liveReferrals` (superseded/carried count as active): pre-existing `activeHeads` semantics, not changed here.

|---|---|
| untrusted text | n/a — no text interpolated; claim is only compared |
| truncated read | n/a — missing/unreadable record means "not covered" |
| shared state | n/a — pure function over the already-read thread |
| rollback / switch | n/a |
| normalization | fixed — one `exactClaimKey` used at table build and at candidate time; line refs kept |
| resource bounds | n/a — `activeInstances` is deduped per (head, claim) |
| trust boundary | n/a — only trusted-author records are read (unchanged) |

## 🔧 conveyor fix — review round (auto-policy blocks on head a0f7ad9e8)

**Fixed head:** `ee9b4e33a` — harness verify GREEN for exactly this sha (#5137), pushed by the harness.

### Findings 1 + 3 — a throwing candidate smoke left the overlay registered (`daemon-load-overlay.mjs:433`)
**Before** (new tests against `a0f7ad9e8`, red): `Tests 11 failed | 65 passed (76)`, among them
- `withDispatchSmoke … a worker launch that THROWS is recorded as a failed smoke in ctl` — got the raw `spawn EMFILE`, `ctl` empty
- `runDaemonLoadOverlay … a candidate worker launch that THROWS removes ONLY this overlay` — `expected "spy" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times` (removeOverlay never ran; only a `smoke-threw` hold)
- `… inspect THROWING fails CLOSED` (candidate and live-clone) — `Error: git diff unreadable` escaped as a rejection

**After:** `daemon-load-overlay.test.mjs` + `daemon-overlay.test.mjs`: `Tests 103 passed (103)`.
- `withDispatchSmoke` now runs the launch through `runDispatchSmokeSafely`: a throw becomes `{ok:false, reason:'smoke-threw'}` in `ctl`, then still throws `dispatch-smoke-failed` so the rebuild holds on last-good (checked in `daemon-rebuild/smoke.mjs`: a `runSmoke` throw → `smoke-threw` hold). The caller then sees `ctl.ran && !ok` and removes ONLY this overlay and rebuilds without it.
- `inspect` failures fail CLOSED (`inspectClosed`) in all three places (candidate, live post-adopt, versioned).

### Finding 4 — version rollback could undo a newer adoption
**Before:** the daemon's `rollback` flips `current → previous` with `expectCurrent` read at call time, so after a newer adoption it re-adopted the failed version. New tests red: the rollback was not told the failed `versionId`; no `rollbackVersionIfCurrent`.
**After:** `rollbackVersionIfCurrent` reads `status()`, does nothing unless `current === versionId` (`current-moved`), else `switchCurrent({id: previous, expectCurrent: versionId, rollback: true, reject: versionId})` — re-checked under the version lock. A moved `current` is reported as `superseded` with the `actual` version, with neutral wording ("left untouched … check that it does not carry this overlay"), never "recovered".

### Finding 2 — versioned loads return before smoke (`:490`)
No new code: answered in round 1 (`5a7ba97cd`): `--wait` smokes the version the request adopted; no `--wait` / not adopted / overlay not in the version runs no worker and says so (`dispatch-smoke-not-run` warning). The in-tick updater builds origin/main only (`overlaysApplied:false`), so an overlay is not applied on a versioned clone today. Making the load refuse or remove instead is a contract change for the updater slice, recorded in the card (acceptance 6) as the `xkhtg2a` follow-up. Raised here for the reviewer; not changed in this round.

- candidate launch throws ✅ · launch resolves to a non-object (`smoke-bad-result`) ✅ · inspect throws (3 sites) ✅ closed
- `removeOverlay` throws (list lock) ✅ reported `removed:false`, STILL REGISTERED, no rebuild on the old list
- rebuild rejects after a failed candidate smoke ✅ still rolls back; a rebuild rejection with no failed smoke is not swallowed (test)
- stale rollback: `current` moved ✅ no switch; moved between read and lock ✅ `aborted/current-moved` passed through
